subject: Next steps: Evaluation kickoff & trial plan for BeaconHealth
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Harris <tom.harris@beaconhealth.org>, Asha Menon <asha.menon@beaconhealth.org>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-12T14:05:00Z
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed slots for evaluation kickoff

Thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning — appreciated the context on your pilot goals. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the evaluation (trial) kickoff on the calendar:

- Objective: Run a 4-week evaluation of Redwood Inference serving a set of clinical summarization and extraction prompts to validate latency, cost-per-token, and extraction accuracy on a masked prompt set.
- Success criteria (initial): mean generation latency < 350ms at 95th pct; specific extraction F1 >= 0.82 on the shared prompt set; no PII leakage in outputs.
- Kickoff goals: align on trial plan, review sample prompt set/evals, map required infra/credentials, and schedule technical deep dive + demo slots.

Proposed 60–75 minute kickoff windows (all times ET):
- Thurs 2026-06-18, 10:00–11:15
- Fri 2026-06-19, 15:30–16:45
- Mon 2026-06-22, 09:30–10:45

Attachments: redwood-eval-plan-v1.pdf (trial plan + agenda), beacon-prompt-set-sample.csv (subset of prompts for initial eval).

Please reply with which slot works or share a few alternatives. For the tech deep dive / demo portion I’ll loop in Vivek (SE) — Vivek, if you can bring a short checklist of infra credentials we’ll need (VPC access, temporary dataset pointers, any dataset sanitization notes).

Thanks — Neha

--
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0128
https://redwood.inference/
From: Tom Harris <tom.harris@beaconhealth.org>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Asha Menon <asha.menon@beaconhealth.org>
Date: 2026-06-12T15:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed slots for evaluation kickoff

Neha — thanks for the clear recap. All three items look right. A few quick notes and availability:  

- We prefer the longer kickoff to include a short technical run-through, so 75 minutes is ideal.
- Availability this week: Friday 06/19 after 15:00 ET looks best for us. If that’s tight, Monday 06/22 morning is our fallback.
- Who should attend from our side: me (product lead), Asha (clinical informatics), and I’ll bring our infra engineer (TBD — likely joining if we do the deep-dive).

Two quick Qs:  
1) For the initial prompt/eval runs, will you need full patient records or can we run against de-identified extracts? We’d prefer de-identified extracts if possible.
2) Can you share a short list of the technical prerequisites we should prepare before the call?

I’ll hold Friday 06/19 15:30-16:45 ET tentatively and will confirm once I sync with the infra engineer.

—Tom
Tom Harris
Senior Product Manager, BeaconHealth
tom.harris@beaconhealth.org | +1 617-555-0199
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Harris <tom.harris@beaconhealth.org>, Asha Menon <asha.menon@beaconhealth.org>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-12T16:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed slots for evaluation kickoff

Perfect — thanks Tom. Friday 06/19 15:30–16:45 ET works on our side; please lock it if that’s your preferred time.

Answers to your Qs and a short prep checklist: 
1) De-identified extracts are ideal for the trial kickoff. For quality checks we sometimes ask for a small, controlled set of partially redacted examples (we’ll never request PHI in plain text). Vivek, I’ll defer to you to confirm exactly what minimal fields we need.
2) Technical prerequisites (short):
   - A sandbox S3 bucket or a secure transfer mechanism for a sample dataset (de-identified).
   - Read-only API credentials or temporary access to a staging dataset (if you prefer us to run directly against a staging instance).
   - Network/test environment notes if you expect us to route to a private VPC (Vivek will follow up with a short checklist).

Agenda for the 75-minute kickoff (suggested):
- 0–10m: Introductions & objectives
- 10–30m: Trial plan walk-through (deliverables, timeline, success criteria)
- 30–55m: Technical deep dive: infra, data access, and security controls (Vivek + infra engineer)
- 55–70m: Live demo / endpoint walkthrough
- 70–75m: Immediate next steps & owners

I’ve attached the evaluation plan and the sample prompt set again (redwood-eval-plan-v1.pdf, beacon-prompt-set-sample.csv). Vivek — can you confirm the exact list of infra items we should ask BeaconHealth to provision before the call? Also, Marissa, I’ll ask you to prepare the onboarding checklist and post-kickoff success metric dashboard we’ll use for the pilot.

If you’re comfortable, I’ll send a calendar invite for Friday 06/19 15:30–16:45 ET with the agenda + prelim materials.

Thanks — Neha

--
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0128
From: Tom Harris <tom.harris@beaconhealth.org>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Asha Menon <asha.menon@beaconhealth.org>
Date: 2026-06-12T17:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed slots for evaluation kickoff

Thanks — Friday works; please go ahead and send the invite.

Asha and I discussed success criteria and added one item: mean token cost per record should be forecasted and estimated at the pilot start so we can compare against our internal benchmark. I’ll add our infra engineer to the calendar invite once I have a name.

See you Friday — Tom

--
Tom Harris
Senior Product Manager, BeaconHealth
